body.x: With the support from Gyeongbuk Technopark Company Support Group, RNS (CEO Kim Jun-seong) will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its scalp measurement system Moa.
This product is a skin measurement device that can measure and examine the basement layer where all kinds of skin diseases starts.

Previously, skin measurement devices and services were difficult to access by individuals because they were in shops and clinics. The skin measurement device Moa is a tool that solves this inconvenience and helps you to find out your current skin condition by accurately measuring your skin.
By receiving information and prescriptions to make my skin in the future, users can purchase and manage the products that suit them and improve their skin according to it.
The company then will accumulate the data and utilize them to provide better service and information to customers.

Gyeongbuk Province has formed Daegu Joint Pavilion where 44 ICT convergence ventures and SMEs and three startups will be participating. Major programs include exhibitions, investor pitching, public relations with foreign media, and post-CES review conferences. In CES 2019, Daegu and Gyeongbuk Province exchanged MOU to run joint pavilion in CES for the benefits of both parties, and the joint pavilion has been set up in CES 2020. The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global technology issues and trends at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
